scope: Audit the PAR-39/7BU XDATA 1009 dynamic string route against the generic DXF value-type and XDATA-specific contracts.

evidence.interpretation: The general group-code table assigns string kind to 1000-1009. The XDATA-specific role list separately enumerates the documented string/control/layer/binary/handle cases, but does not assign an XDATA role to 1009. Therefore generic string classification alone is insufficient to admit 1009 through the typed XDATA writer. This does not establish that code 1009 is invalid in every DXF context.
